summary: This Layer 1B pass expands the universe around the less obvious nuclear-power chokepoints behind AI data-center electricity demand. The clearest node-level signal is that hyperscaler demand is validating nuclear baseload through long-term power arrangements, while the harder second-order constraints may sit in HALEU enrichment, radiation monitoring and reactor instrumentation, heat-transfer and turbomachinery components, and speculative alternative enrichment technologies. The list intentionally limits mega-cap utilities and SMR developers, using them mainly as context anchors, and prioritizes US-listed small/mid-cap or niche companies with plausibly underappreciated exposure.
